description: Election Commission - Dclare that K. Ethirveerasingam as a member of the Vadamarachchi South West P.S.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it deals with electoral procedures and filling vacancies in elected positions.
